violations.description: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
violations.reason: The agent changed the reservation destination from LGA to EWR. Step 7 shows the existing reservation 43TOIE has destination LGA, step 2 shows the user requested a change to EWR, and steps 16-17 show the agent called update_reservation_flights for flight HAT015 and the resulting reservation now has destination EWR. This violates the policy restriction that other reservations can be modified only without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
